name: Shukumi Hinase
source:
The third sister, the younger twin, works as a lively salesclerk at a buckwheat noodle shop. She has a passion for cosplay and appears to have a secret hobby.

「This time, I'm definitely going for the ultra dream jumbo parfait for lunch, Onii!」
